pages.title: John III Doukas Vatatzes
pages.extract: John III Doukas Vatatzes, Latinized as Ducas Vatatzes (Greek: Ἰωάννης Γ´ Δούκας Βατάτζης, romanized: Iōánnēs Doúkās Vatatzēs; c. 1192 – 3 November 1254), was Emperor of Nicaea from 1221 to 1254. He was succeeded by his son, known as Theodore II Doukas Laskaris.

pages.title: Earl Township, Lancaster County, Pennsylvania
pages.extract: Earl Township is a township in northeastern Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, United States. The population was 7,149 at the 2020 census.

pages.title: Dixieland Plus
pages.extract: Dixieland Plus is an album by Dixieland Jazz band Dixieland Plus, which included a 10 year oldHarry Connick Jr. It was their debut album, recorded Live in New Orleans, Louisiana on Oct. 29-30, 1977. Connick was age 10 at the time of the recording and was simultaneously studying with local piano masters Ellis Marsalis and James Booker.

pages.title: Downfall (Matchbox Twenty song)
pages.extract: "Downfall" is a song by American rock band Matchbox Twenty. The song was written by producer Matt Serletic and lead singer Rob Thomas. It was released in February 2004 as the fourth US single from their 2002 album, More Than You Think You Are, alongside "All I Need", which was released on the same day in Australia. "Downfall" reached number 27 on the US Billboard Adult Top 40 chart in mid-2004.

pages.title: Pinacoplus
pages.extract: Pinacoplus is a genus of owlet moths in the family Noctuidae. This genus has a single species, Pinacoplus didymogramma.

pages.title: Shadow and Substance
pages.extract: Shadow and Substance is a four-act play written in 1937 by Paul Vincent Carroll. In 1938 it won the New York Drama Critics' Circle award for Best Foreign Play.

pages.title: Friedrich Hassaurek
pages.extract: Friedrich Hassaurek (8 October 1831 – 3 October 1885) was an American journalist and ambassador.

pages.title: Masumabad, Semnan
pages.extract: Masumabad (Persian: معصوم اباد, also Romanized as Ma‘şūmābād) is a village in Qohab-e Rastaq Rural District, Amirabad District, Damghan County, Semnan Province, Iran. At the 2006 census, its population was 20, in 9 families.

pages.title: Gazeran, Farahan
pages.extract: Gazeran (Persian: گازران, also Romanized as Gāzerān; also known as Gazrah and Kāzerūn) is a village in Farmahin Rural District, in the Central District of Farahan County, Markazi Province, Iran. At the 2006 census, its population was 209, in 52 families.

pages.title: Machias, Maine
pages.extract: Machias (, mə-CHY-əss) is a town in and the county seat of Washington County in Down East Maine, United States. As of the 2020 census, the town population was 2,060. It contains the census-designated place of the same name. It is home to the University of Maine at Machias and Machias Valley Airport, a small public airport owned by the town. The word Machias roughly translates in Passamaquoddy as "bad little falls", a reference to the Machias River. Machias was the site of the first naval battle of the American Revolution.

pages.title: United States v. Huck Manufacturing Co.
Stenocranus dorsalis
pages.extract: Stenocranus dorsalis is a species of delphacid planthopper in the family Delphacidae. It is found in the Caribbean and North America.

pages.title: Natalie Finnemore
pages.extract: Natalie Finnemore (born 1988) is a British visual artist who creates sculptural installations. Finnemore's artistic practice utilises drawing, printmaking, painting and sculpture. Her sculptural work is influenced by design, and explores the viewer's expectations or relationship with form, function and play.

pages.title: My Love: Six Stories of True Love
Oleksandr Bakumenko
pages.extract: Oleksandr Borysovych Bakumenko (Ukrainian: Олекса́ндр Бори́сович Баку́менко; 29 April 1959 – 11 April 2022) was a Ukrainian politician. A member of European Solidarity, he served in the Verkhovna Rada from 2014 to 2019. He died on 11 April 2022 at the age of 62.

pages.title: Kachanivka, Ternopil Oblast
pages.description: Rural locality in Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine
pages.extract: Kachanivka (Ukrainian: Качанівка) is a village in Pidvolochysk settlement hromada, Ternopil Raion, Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine.

pages.title: Omagh rail tragedy
pages.description: 1950 railway accident in Omagh, Northern Ireland
pages.extract: The Omagh rail tragedy was a railway accident on 24 November 1950 in Omagh, County Tyrone, Northern Ireland, that killed five railway workers. They were struck by a passenger train while carrying out maintenance on the Derry Road line in heavy fog, and the noise of another train idling in the station prevented them from hearing the oncoming train.
